summary.title: Threat Model for Fintech Core Banking Demo
summary.description: Comprehensive STRIDE/LINDDUN Threat Model with Automated Boundary & Flow Synthesis.

threats.title: Adversary JWT Forgery or Replay via Weak Signature / Missing Alg Enforcement
threats.description: Adversary signs forged authentication tokens using HMAC secret or 'none' algorithm to spoof arbitrary administrative identities.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict RS256/ES256 asymmetric signature validation with centralized JWKS and reject tokens missing non-reusable 'jti' claim.

threats.title: SQL Injection & Transaction State Alteration via Unsanitized Parameters
threats.description: Untrusted parameters in database query building allow attackers to alter database record state and bypass logic barriers.
threats.mitigation: Mandate ORM-level parameterized statements, disable dynamic raw query concatenation, and apply row-level DB access controls.

threats.title: Missing Non-Repudiation Audit Logs on State-Altering Operations
threats.description: Financial transfers, password resets, and permission grants lack immutable transaction audit logs.
threats.mitigation: Emit structured JSON audit events to append-only, tamper-evident log stores with actor ID, IP, and UTC timestamp.

threats.title: Verbose Server Headers & Production Stack Trace Leakage
threats.description: API Gateway returns internal stack traces, container environment details, and server versions upon unhandled exceptions.
threats.mitigation: Implement global exception handling middleware with sanitized generic error envelopes and suppress Server/X-Powered-By banners.

threats.title: Resource Exhaustion via Unbounded Queries & Lack of Rate Limiting (API4)
threats.description: Endpoints accepting pagination or cryptographic hashing lack request rate limiting and payload size bounds.
threats.mitigation: Deploy token-bucket rate limiters at reverse proxy (e.g. NGINX/Envoy), enforce max body size caps, and enforce hard page limits (max 100).

threats.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) on Data Resources (API1)
threats.description: Endpoint controllers read resource identifiers from request paths without verifying caller tenant ownership.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict authorization checks in data layer scoping all queries to current_user.tenant_id.
